say:1:1536123001:1.text: They say you might see the Hunting Goddess herself! She hasn't shown up here in a while.
say:1:1536123001:1.source_cn: 听说能有机会见到狩猎神啊！她好久都没降临雅库伯尔了。
say:1:1536123001:1.male: They say you might see the Hunting Goddess herself! She hasn't shown up here in a while.
say:1:1536123001:1.female: They say you might see the Hunting Goddess herself! She hasn't shown up here in a while.

say:2:1536123002:1.text: But I didn't even pass the tryout... So many of us didn't.
say:2:1536123002:1.source_cn: 可我连选拔都没通过……跟我一样的战士还有几百几千个。
say:2:1536123002:1.male: But I didn't even pass the tryout... So many of us didn't.
say:2:1536123002:1.female: But I didn't even pass the tryout... So many of us didn't.

say:3:1536123003:1.text: Guess I'm only good enough to guard this place.
say:3:1536123003:1.source_cn: 我的实力，只配当山谷的守卫吧，唉。
say:3:1536123003:1.male: Guess I'm only good enough to guard this place.
say:3:1536123003:1.female: Guess I'm only good enough to guard this place.
